verdict.rationale: First-party docs include an "API Access & Keys" page (docs.anythingllm.com/features/api), so a documented public API with key-based access exists. The pack gives only the page title, though, and probes found no published OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the standard docs paths. That absence is a gap, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: endpoint coverage showing the API can drive workspaces, chats, documents and agents; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec; any independent or hands-on confirmation of using the API.
